name: io.pinbridge/pinbridge
description: Publish and schedule Pinterest pins from any MCP client. Connect a Pinterest account once and PinBridge handles OAuth token refresh, rate limits, retries and delivery status.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using a PinBridge API key, in the form 'Bearer pb_<64 hex characters>'. Create a key in the PinBridge dashboard at https://www.pinbridge.io. The free Playground plan works.
